race.comment: MAGIC INVADER (1) looks the main danger on the strength of his broader maiden profile, with nine placings from 15 starts. His last-start sixth at Sunshine Coast was plain, but the prior Gold Coast third when favourite reads well for this, and a trial win between suggests he's up to the mark.  DEMES GIRL (11) had genuine interference at Toowoomba last start and her Gatton third two runs ago showed enough to suggest she can be competitive. BUSTERBOY (6) was much better when fourth at Coffs Harbour, is fourth-up now, and the first-time visors give him enough improvement room to press for a minor end of the prize. FROSTY LOOKS (4) has trialled well and has to be included on debut from the soft draw.
